verdict.rationale: Kintsugi exposes per-jurisdiction filing data through the API: Get Filings filters by date, jurisdiction, country and status, and filings can also be queried by registration ID. It also lists nexuses, files and remits on schedule, and adjusts filings for credit notes, which gives some filing-ready detail by jurisdiction. Nothing shows a real-time accrued-liability view, a collected-versus-owed comparison, or exports for accountants and GLs; the accounting connectors are described only as inbound transaction sync. Missing for 10: real-time accrued liability by jurisdiction, collected vs owed reconciliation, accountant/GL export formats, independent corroboration.
